hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log" && jq -c '{ts:(now|todate), tool:.tool_name, input:(.tool_input | {file_path, command, pattern, url, name} | with_entries(select(.value != null)) | map_values(tostring | .[0:200])), result:"ok", session:.session_id, source:"claude-code"}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log/claude-code.jsonl"

mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log" && jq -c '{ts:(now|todate), tool:.tool_name, input:(.tool_input | {file_path, command, pattern, url, name} | with_entries(select(.value != null)) | map_values(tostring | .[0:200])), result:"error", session:.session_id, source:"claude-code"}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-log/claude-code.jsonl"
